title: EAOA League & Champs
text:
Just a reminder that the presentation of the mementos to the 2016 EA League age class winners will take place at SOS's Writtle event on April 2nd, at approx. 13:30. There's an overall list of the winners on the EAOA website & the SuffOC winners can be found here.

The 2017 EAOA Championships will be held at SMOC's Rushmere event on March 19th. All members of EAOA clubs are eligible. The normal results are used for the championship calculations, so nothing extra is required - just enter the event in the usual way, preferably via Fabian4. The presentation of trophies takes place at the end of the event, so 2016 class winners will need to engrave & return their trophies in good time.
